name: UP Post-Matric (Dashmottar) Scholarship — SC / ST
description: For SC and ST students of Uttar Pradesh in graduation, post-graduation, diploma and other post-matric courses (other than Class 11-12). Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Fresh applications close 31 Oct 2026; renewal closed 15 Oct 2026. Class 11-12 (Intermediate) fresh applications already closed on 21 Sep 2026.
